entries.what: Dulce walks the 12 minutes down Vinca to Flats High for geometry and English, then sits through Ms. Tolentino's third-period chemistry with Karina as lab partner.
entries.outcome: Finished the day's lab data table on time.

entries.what: Eats lunch at the planters by the B wing with Brianna, Karina and Sienna, then goes home to Marisol Gardens unit 114 for homework.
entries.outcome: Everyone still sits together; plenty of group chat jokes.

entries.what: Texts in 'las 4 fantásticas' late and falls asleep a bit after 11:30.
entries.outcome: Slept late.

entries.what: School day: geometry, chemistry, PE volleyball unit. Dulce is quick at the molar mass practice problems.
entries.outcome: Got the math right before Karina did.

entries.what: After school she and friends stop at Cloud Nine Tea Bar, where Kyla gives extra pearls, and Dulce orders a taro slush.
entries.outcome: Spent a few dollars on the group again.

entries.what: Home by curfew; Yesenia gets home from her St. Anselm shift and they eat dinner together.
entries.outcome: Quiet evening, homework done.

entries.what: Wednesday classes: English 10, world history and Spanish for heritage speakers.
entries.outcome: Normal school day.

entries.what: Eats lunch at the B wing planters with the group and works on the chem lab conclusion afterward.
entries.outcome: Wrote a short conclusion and moved on.

entries.what: Chats with friends at night and edits a video clip she will never post.
entries.outcome: Stayed up a little late.

entries.what: Thursday at school with chemistry third period, then a bus and a walk home.
entries.outcome: Turned in the lab on time.

entries.what: Evening at home with homework while Yesenia cooks; Dulce checks her phone fund total and counts it out.
entries.outcome: Pleased with growing savings.

entries.what: Phone battery dies before dinner, so she charges it while doing geometry.
entries.outcome: Finished homework.

entries.what: Friday at school, then a 22 bus ride down Calle Ortega to Taquería Colima for her 4-9 shift taking orders.
entries.outcome: Worked the register through the dinner rush.

entries.what: Héctor jokes loudly at the grill during the rush and slows the ticket line; Dulce privately finds him a show-off.
entries.outcome: Line backed up for a few minutes; she kept it to herself.

entries.what: After her check, Yesenia sets a rule: Dulce keeps her paycheck but puts $20 per check toward her phone bill. Rafael picks her up after the 9 p.m. close.
entries.outcome: Agreed to the rule; the phone fund grows a little slower.

entries.what: Saturday morning laundry at the card-only laundry room in Marisol Gardens.
entries.outcome: Two loads done.

entries.what: Hears about the Ridgeline hiring fair downtown; Aaliyah is hired as a seasonal picker there. Dulce picks up the news at the market with her mom.
entries.outcome: Nothing for her, just town chatter.

entries.what: Afternoon hanging out with friends at Plaza Marisol and she buys one round of boba.
entries.outcome: Spent a bit less than usual.

entries.what: Sunday 10-4 shift at Taquería Colima taking orders next to Camila and Héctor.
entries.outcome: Long shift, got through it.

entries.what: Takes her free shift plate, a quesadilla, then rides the 22 bus home.
entries.outcome: Home before dark.

entries.what: Starts the week's chem homework and goes to bed on time.
entries.outcome: Finished half before sleep.
